notes.title: New Update 1.1 - Saving feature!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello my friends!
A new update is now available for you, it includes saving feature on collectables.

Now when you collect an item, it get stored and saved in the game system, this way when you open up the game again the score will be saved!

The update includes even some of the features suggested in the forum discussion, go check them out! :foxspirit: 	[/h1]

- MalboM

notes.title: Heaven Forest NIGHTS Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello my friends! :heavenforest:

We're happy to announce that our new game Heaven Forest NIGHTS is now released on Steam.

We hope you'll have fun!

[b]
Features of the game:

- Single and Multiplayer online mode
- Achievements
- Cards and Badges
- VR Mode for Oculus and VIVE available!	[/b]

:foresttrees:
[/h1]
